name: Tsubomi
source:
She is the most demure of the four.
She’s a natural at taking care of others and excels at all kinds of household chores, including cooking.
She acts as the group’s leader. She is always modest,
never insists on her own opinions, and prioritizes everyone else’s wishes. 

[Translated from [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/84901/]Getchu[/url]]
